teaser.en: Children go looking for its fruit, while carpenters want its hard red-yellow heartwood for pestles and mortars.
teaser.sw: Watoto huenda kutafuta matunda yake, nao maseremala hutaka kiini chake kigumu chekundu-njano kwa michi na vinu.
teaser.dg: Ana nkuhendza matundage, na mafundi a mbao nkumendza chiini chigumu cha muhi uhu, cha rangi ya kundu na mandano, kpwa kuhenda mitsi na vinu.

summary.en: *Mtsamvia* is a tall tree of riverine and groundwater forest with a pillar-like buttressed trunk and edible fruits. Children especially enjoy the fruit pulp, and the hard heartwood makes pestles, mortars and building poles.
summary.sw: *Mtsamvia*, au *msamvia*, ni mti mrefu wa misitu ya kando ya mito na misitu ya maji ya ardhini wenye shina kama nguzo lenye mizizi-ukuta na matunda yanayoliwa. Watoto hasa hufurahia nyama ya tunda lake, na kiini kigumu cha mbao zake hutengeneza michi, vinu na nguzo za ujenzi.
summary.dg: *Mtsamvia* ni muhi mure wa matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho na ga madzi ga tsini, wenye kolo ririrogoloka dza nguzo, renye ngamba photsi, na matunda ganayoriwa. Ana hasa nkumendza nyama ya matunda, na chiini chigumu nkuhendwa mitsi, vinu na nguzo za kudzengera.

about.en:
*Mtsamvia* can grow to 25 metres, with a straight, pillar-like bole buttressed at the base. The bark is grey and scaly, and it bleeds white latex when cut. The leaves are long and widest near the tip. The fruits are edible.

Inside, the heartwood is hard and red-yellow.
about.sw:
*Mtsamvia* unaweza kufikia urefu wa mita 25, ukiwa na shina lililonyooka kama nguzo lenye mizizi-ukuta chini. Gome ni la kijivu na lenye magamba, na hutoa utomvu mweupe linapokatwa. Majani ni marefu na mapana zaidi karibu na ncha. Matunda yake huliwa.

Ndani, kiini cha mbao ni kigumu na cha rangi nyekundu-njano.
about.dg:
*Mtsamvia* unaweza kufika mita ishirini na tsano, wenye kolo ririrogoloka dza nguzo, renye ngamba photsi. Gopha ni ra rangi ya ivu na rinatuluka vipande-vipande, na richikatwa rinalavya maziya mereru. Makodza ni mare, na ni mapana zaidi phephi na ntsa.

Ndani, chiini ni chigumu na cha rangi ya kundu na mandano.

where.en: It grows in riverine forest and groundwater forest, where the water table is high.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya kando ya mito na misitu ya maji ya ardhini, mahali ambapo kiwango cha maji chini ya ardhi kiko juu.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho na matsaka ga madzi ga tsini, ambapho madzi ga tsini ga phephi na dzulu.

uses.en:
The fruit pulp is eaten, especially by children.

The hard heartwood is used for pestles and mortars and for building poles.
uses.sw:
Nyama ya tunda huliwa, hasa na watoto.

Kiini kigumu cha mbao hutumika kwa michi na vinu na kwa nguzo za ujenzi.
uses.dg:
Nyama ya matunda nkuriwa, hasa ni ana.

Chiini chigumu nkuhumirwa kuhenda mitsi na vinu, na nguzo za kudzengera.

names.en: Pakia and the ICRAF handbook give the Digo name *mtsamvia*, with *msami* as another name. In Swahili it is *msamvia*. There is no common English name.
names.sw: Pakia na kitabu cha ICRAF vinatoa jina la Kidigo *mtsamvia*, na *msami* kama jina jingine. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *msamvia*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza linalojulikana sana.
names.dg: Pakia anapha dzina ra Chidigo *mtsamvia*, na chitabu cha ICRAF piya, na *msami* ni dzina ranjina. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *msamvia*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza rinarohumirwa sana.
